equation: dX(t) = r * X(t) * dt + sigma * X(t) * dW(t)
diffusion_derivative: dg/dX = sigma  (scalar 1D: g(X) = sigma*X, so dg/dX = sigma)
milstein_correction: 0.5 * sigma * X_n * sigma * (dW**2 - dt)  =  0.5 * sigma**2 * X_n * (dW**2 - dt)
implementation_notes: Risk-neutral Black-Scholes asset price, mathematically identical to GBM with drift mu = r. Scalar multiplicative noise. X stays positive given X_0 = 100 > 0, so no positivity guard needed. Milstein eligible (g(X) = sigma*X, dg/dX = sigma). Exact mean E[X(T)] = X_0*exp(r*T) ~= 105.13; variance ~= large (order 1e2-1e3), so mean check applies (|mean| >> near_zero_threshold).
